name: Tianyu Digital Technology (Dalian) Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Tianyu Digital Technology (Dalian) Group Co., Ltd. specializes in creating and releasing video games across multiple platforms, including mobile phones, personal computers, and dedicated gaming consoles. Furthermore, the company's operations extend into online advertising, the distribution of applications for iOS devices, and the production of cinematic and television content. This enterprise previously traded under the name Dalian Zeus Entertainment Co., Ltd. Founded in 2003, its corporate headquarters are located in Beijing, China.
